2608.27513.title: DAMP: Decay-Aware Mixed-Precision Recurrent-State Quantization
2608.27513.paper_summary: Softmax attention stores key and value vectors for every preceding token, causing inference memory to grow with sequence length. Recent language models incorporating Gated DeltaNet (GDN) or Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) reduce this cost by replacing the KV cache in most layers with fixed-size recurrent states. However, these recurrent states are commonly stored in FP32 and consume substantial GPU memory; their updates are memory-bandwidth bound and contribute significantly to decoding latency. To our knowledge, we are the first to study post-training quantization of recurrent states in GDN and KDA based language models. We find that uniform quantization provides a poor accuracy--storage trade-off: INT8 and FP8 already degrade accuracy on complex reasoning tasks, while INT4 and NVFP4 reduce it to near zero. We further find that most quantization-error energy is concentrated in a small subset of channels and that the relative decay strength of state channels remains stable across prompts and tasks. Motivated by these findings, DAMP uses both quantization-error energy and decay-based persistence to identify high-risk channels during offline calibration. It stores these channels at higher precision and the remainder in INT8. We evaluate DAMP on Qwen3.6-35B and Kimi-Linear-48B across six benchmarks covering mathematical reasoning, general reasoning, and code generation. At 9.9 bits per state value, DAMP maintains average accuracy close to the FP32 baseline. DAMP reduces recurrent-state storage by 69.1%, accelerates the recurrent-state update kernel by up to 2.01x, and lowers full-model TPOT by up to 10.9%.
2608.27513.paper_summary_zh: Softmax 注意力為每個前置標記儲存鍵和值向量，導致推理記憶體隨著序列長度增加而增長。最近的語言模型結合了 Gated DeltaNet (GDN) 或 Kimi Delta Attention (KDA)，通過在大多數層中用固定大小的遞迴狀態替換 KV 快取來降低這一成本。然而，這些遞迴狀態通常以 FP32 儲存，並消耗大量 GPU 記憶體；它們的更新受到記憶體帶寬的限制，並顯著影響解碼延遲。據我們所知，我們是第一個研究 GDN 和 KDA 基礎語言模型中遞迴狀態後訓練量化的團隊。我們發現均勻量化提供了不佳的準確性與儲存之間的權衡：INT8 和 FP8 在複雜推理任務中已經降低了準確性，而 INT4 和 NVFP4 將其降低至接近零。我們進一步發現，大多數量化誤差能量集中在一小部分通道中，並且狀態通道的相對衰減強度在不同提示和任務中保持穩定。受到這些發現的激勵，DAMP 利用量化誤差能量和基於衰減的持久性來識別離線校準過程中的高風險通道。它以更高的精度儲存這些通道，其餘部分則以 INT8 儲存。我們在 Qwen3.6-35B 和 Kimi-Linear-48B 上評估 DAMP，涵蓋數學推理、一般推理和代碼生成的六個基準。在每個狀態值 9.9 位的情況下，DAMP 維持接近 FP32 基線的平均準確性。DAMP 減少了 69.1% 的遞迴狀態儲存，將遞迴狀態更新內核的速度提高至 2.01 倍，並將全模型 TPOT 降低至 10.9%。
